hero.description: Back-end developer for 5 years, building distributed services in Go and Node.js. Currently at a healthtech; before that, back-end of the Gunbound relaunch.

about-me.title: About me
about-me.description1: I'm currently a senior back-end developer at a care-focused healthtech, where I build distributed services in NestJS and Go with Clean Architecture and a modular structure, integrate payment systems and handle sensitive health data under Brazil's LGPD, using PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis.
about-me.description2: Before that, I spent 2 years at Inside Code owning the back-end of the Gunbound relaunch, averaging 2,000 concurrent players with weekend peaks of 10,000: a Go game server with event-driven architecture on serverless AWS, player sessions in Redis and a data lake on Firehose and S3. And before that, a year and a half on a digital-asset analytics platform with over 1,000 customers.
about-me.description3: I work with real event-driven systems (Kafka, SQS, EventBridge), observability before the incident (Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, New Relic) and code that ages well (Clean Architecture, DDD, TDD, Testcontainers). MBA in Software Architecture from Full Cycle. Open to roles in fintech, healthtech and games.

events.title: Full Stack Developer - Rizzo Dev
events.description: Digital-asset analytics platform used by over 1,000 customers, with real-time market monitoring and strategy backtesting. I worked from data ingestion all the way to the dashboards.
specification: • Go services for concurrent real-time processing, backtesting and notifications.
• Node.js and TypeScript microservices behind an API Gateway: accounts, strategy creation and live-data webhooks.
• Collection and normalization of hundreds of market assets (Ethereum/NFTs and tokens) via TypeScript scraping.
• Lower latency and database load with Redis caching and concurrent processing.
• Real-time dashboards in React and Next.js for over 1,000 customers.
• Containerized environment with Docker and CI/CD for build, test and deploy.

events.title: Back-End Developer - Inside Code
events.description: Back-end of the Gunbound relaunch, an online multiplayer artillery game averaging 2,000 concurrent players with weekend peaks of 10,000, on a team of 4 developers.
specification: • Full game back-end in Go with event-driven architecture for real-time matches.
• End-to-end serverless AWS: API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS, S3, EC2, SQS, EventBridge, Firehose, VPC and Route 53.
• Player state and sessions in Redis, allowing moves between servers without losing context.
• Queues and async processing with SQS and EventBridge, sustaining the 10,000-player peak.
• Data pipeline and data lake with Firehose and S3 for match, login and action metrics.
• RESTful APIs in Go, Node.js and Java integrated with distributed services.
• Data modeling, UML diagrams and integration flows between microservices.
• Unit, integration and load testing.
• Mentoring junior developers and supporting the team's architecture decisions.

events.title: Senior Back-End Developer - CLYVO
events.description: Care-focused healthtech. Responsible for platform services and for shipping complete features across the care flow.
specification: • Distributed services in Node.js/NestJS and Go with Clean Architecture and a modular structure.
• Payment system integration covering the billing flow end to end.
• Handling sensitive health data in compliance with Brazil's LGPD.
• Observability with Datadog: metrics, logs and traces in production.
• PostgreSQL for the relational core, MongoDB for semi-structured data and Redis for caching.
• Shipping complete features, from technical design to deploy.
• Back-end technical reference for the team.

kafkaObservability.title: Observability with Kafka and OpenTelemetry
kafkaObservability.description: Distributed order system in Go with Kafka showing end-to-end observability: distributed traces, business metrics, structured logs, baggage and error handling, all visible in Grafana and Kibana APM.

goBoilerplate.title: SaaS API boilerplate in Go
goBoilerplate.description: REST API base for SaaS back-ends with JWT auth, plans and subscriptions, payments and Redis caching. Module-based Clean Architecture, dependency injection with Uber fx, OpenTelemetry telemetry and integration tests with Testcontainers.

coolerDisplay.title: Temperature display for TGT coolers
coolerDisplay.description: Linux service in Go that reads the CPU temperature from system sensors and sends it to the cooler's display over HID every second, running as a systemd service.
